def test(Pi,Pj,Qlist):
    P=[t**i*A**j for i in Pi for j in Pj]
    Q=[r*(A**q) if False else r*q for q in Qlist]  # placeholder
    cols=P+[ -r*(A**q) for q in Qlist]

    # normalize columns

    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(M,full_matrices=False)
    return s[-1]/s[0], vt[-1]
